headline: Lee Hyung-il: "Even if Differential Easing Applies to Non-Resident Single Homes, Some Difference Should Remain" [Real Estate Tax Struggle]
summary: Lee Hyung-il, nominee for deputy prime minister for economy and finance minister, reaffirmed that property tax normalisation will keep a residence-centred housing policy. He said some difference should remain for non-resident single homes.
why: Property tax rules shape housing demand, household wealth and government revenue, making them a key policy area for South Korean real estate and financial markets.
